intro: The Turncoat centers on an Al'Aketh cultist attempting to defect and trade the cult's true intentions for the island in exchange for safe harbor. Dispatched to extract him from a secluded retreat in the highlands northwest of Valanaar, travelers must uncover whether this secret meeting is a genuine breakthrough or a deadly trap.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

This defector is hiding at a secluded residence just northwest of Valanaar inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, it's worth some risk.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This man is clearly dead, killed by the assassins that you fought outside the house. As you kneel down to inspect the body you notice the glinting reflection of something shiny...

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
